card.text: A spiral galaxy 6.7 million parsecs away, seen almost face-on.

sources.label: Riess et al. (2016), ApJ 826, 56, Table 5, row M101
Walter et al. (2008), THINGS: The H I Nearby Galaxy Survey, Table 1

introduction.text: Its distance comes from its Cepheid variable stars. Deep images trace its disc of stars to nearly 50 kiloparsecs from the centre.

sources.label: Riess et al. (2016), ApJ 826, 56, Table 5, row M101
Mihos et al. (2013), The Extended Optical Disk of M101
sources.quote: has revealed the stellar structure of M101's disk out to nearly 25 arcminutes (50 kpc)

optical.title: M101 in visible light
optical.summary: Visible-light image, flat on its measured disc; depths are not measured.

sources.label: M101; Pinwheel Galaxy; T.A. Rector (University of Alaska Anchorage) and H. Schweiker (WIYN and NOIRLab/NSF/AURA)
